_comment: Colours of the Slotmap Overview drawing — one set for both the thumbnail in the cell and the popup on hover. Compiled into the web bundle at build time — never fetched at runtime. 'categories' maps a category to regexes matched against a slot map cell label (mirror suffix removed); the first matching category wins, anything else is 'other'. A colour is "#rrggbb" or {"light": ..., "dark": ...} per page theme; dark neutral boxes (black, dark gray) turn white / light gray in dark mode. Absent pages are transparent; empty pages (slot confirmed, nothing mapped) are drawn in 'grid', in the popup with a 1 px inward outline in 'empty_outline'. Box text (popup) is black or white, whichever contrasts best.
